sloka: सर्वाभरणसर्वाङ्गः शूलपाणिः स राक्षसः।त्रिविक्रमकृतोत्साहो नारायण इवाबभौ ।। ६.६५.३१ ।।
transliteration: sarvābharaṇasarvāṅgaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ sa rākṣasaḥ।trivikramakṛtotsāho nārāyaṇa ivābabhau ।। 6.65.31 ।।

translations.english: Decked with ornaments on all his limbs, with pike in hand, the Rakshasa was like Narayana ready to take three strides to cover the universe. Endowed with great strength, embraced his brother, went round in reverence bowing down his head and sallied forth.
translations.hindi: अब तुम क्रोध को शान्त कर स्वस्थ हो जाओ | ह्वे राजम्‌! सेरे जीते तुमको अपने समन“मै कभी ऐसा विचार न लाना चाहिये
